nodes.label: --brand-primary (#223A71)
nodes.rationale: Core navy of the brand pair. Carries the logo and every heading; aliased as --text-heading so components never touch the raw value. Used for slide titles, display type, and mono command text on snow.

nodes.label: --brand-deep (#142447)
nodes.rationale: The darker half of the navy pair. Exists so there is one, and only one, dark slide surface (--surface-slide-dark); white text on it measures 14:1, which survives a projector.

nodes.label: --brand-sky (#38B6D9)
nodes.rationale: The sky accent. Means STRUCTURE, never state: rules/hairline accents, buttons, technical detail, bullet dots. Also the focus ring. Paired against teal so a single slide never uses two accents for the same meaning.

nodes.label: --brand-teal (#16C7B7)
nodes.rationale: The teal accent. Means STATE, never structure: current step, completed, progress. Kept distinct from sky so progress indication is never confused with decoration.

nodes.label: Raw brand palette (navy pair + sky + teal)
nodes.rationale: The four core swatches: brand-primary #223A71, brand-deep #142447, brand-sky #38B6D9, brand-teal #16C7B7. This is the raw layer -- components are forbidden from referencing it directly and must go through the semantic aliases.
